.helpBody{padding:16px;display:grid;gap:14px}.helpHero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:14px}.helpCard{padding:14px;border:1px solid #343d45;border-radius:8px;background:#11161b}.helpCard h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.13em;color:#8fd7fa}.helpCard p{margin:6px 0;color:#b8c1c8;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}.helpSteps{display:grid;gap:7px;counter-reset:steps}.helpStep{display:grid;grid-template-columns:26px 1fr;gap:8px;align-items:start;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;color:#c9d0d5}.helpStep:before{counter-increment:steps;content:counter(steps);width:22px;height:22px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;background:#2c607a;color:white;font-weight:800;font-size:10px}.shortcutGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(160px,.8fr) 1fr;gap:6px 12px;font-size:11px}.shortcutGrid kbd{justify-self:start;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #4a535c;background:#22282e;box-shadow:0 1px 0 #ffffff12 inset;color:#e7ebee;font:700 10px/1.2 ui-monospace,monospace}.shortcutGrid span{color:#b4bdc4}.helpActions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.helpActions button{min-height:32px!important;height:32px!important;font-size:9px!important}.helpFine{font-size:10px!important;color:#87929b!important}
.p25Toast{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:42px;z-index:100000;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid #46515a;border-radius:6px;background:#161b20;color:#dbe1e5;box-shadow:0 12px 30px #0008;font:600 10px/1.3 system-ui,sans-serif;opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px);pointer-events:none;transition:.16s}.p25Toast.show{opacity:1;transform:none}

body.simpleUI[data-model="sr16"] .panel:before{content:"STEREO DRUM MACHINE"!important}
body.simpleUI .primaryTools:before{display:none!important}
body.simpleUI .primaryTools button{width:auto!important;max-width:none!important;min-height:30px!important;height:30px!important;flex:0 0 94px!important;padding:4px 10px!important}
body.simpleUI .primaryTools>b{display:block!important;flex:0 0 auto!important;color:var(--p20-label)!important;font:900 8px/1 ui-monospace,monospace!important;letter-spacing:.16em!important}
body.simpleUI .seqwrap:before{content:"STEP SEQUENCER"!important}
body.simpleUI .brandblock{padding-left:30px!important}
@media(max-width:760px) and (orientation:portrait){
 .appTitlebar{height:36px!important;padding:0 7px!important;gap:7px!important}
 .appTitle{font-size:11px!important;white-space:nowrap!important;overflow:hidden!important;text-overflow:ellipsis!important}
 .appTitle small,.appSession,.winBtns{display:none!important}
 .appToolbar{height:42px!important;padding:4px 6px!important;gap:4px!important;overflow:hidden!important}
 .appToolbar .toolBtn:not(.help),.appToolbar .toolSep,.appToolbar .toolbarLabel,.appRomChip{display:none!important}
 .appToolbar #appModelChip,.appToolbar .appLenChip{display:flex!important;height:32px!important}
 .appToolbar #appModelChip{max-width:128px!important;overflow:hidden!important;text-overflow:ellipsis!important}
 .toolBtn.help{display:block!important;margin-left:auto!important;width:36px!important;height:34px!important}
 .machine>.header{display:none!important}
 body.simpleUI .brandblock{padding-left:0!important}
 body.simpleUI .primaryTools{gap:5px!important;padding:7px!important}
 body.simpleUI .primaryTools>b{width:100%!important;flex-basis:100%!important}
 body.simpleUI .primaryTools button{flex:1 1 82px!important;min-width:0!important}
 body.simpleUI .panel:before{content:"DRUM MACHINE"!important;top:84px!important;font-size:7px!important}
}
@media(max-height:560px) and (orientation:landscape){
 .appTitle small,.appSession,.winBtns{display:none!important}
 .appToolbar .toolBtn.load,.appToolbar .toolBtn.save,.appToolbar .toolBtn.undo,.appToolbar .toolBtn.redo,.appToolbar .toolBtn.midi,.appToolbar .toolBtn.settings{display:none!important}
 .appToolbar .toolSep{display:none!important}
 .appToolbar .help{margin-left:auto!important}
 .machine>.header{display:none!important}
 body.simpleUI .primaryTools button{flex:0 0 78px!important}
}
</style>
